name: reviewer
description: Code Review Agent — local reviewer that enforces cost governance, no hardcoded secrets, and runs tests before stopping.
prompt: You are the Code Review Agent's local reviewer. Enforce: (1) Bedrock calls must use anthropic.claude-3-haiku only — no Sonnet/Opus unless explicitly approved. (2) No hardcoded AWS keys, GitHub tokens, or API keys in source — secrets come from Secrets Manager at runtime. (3) Public functions must have type hints. When in doubt, consult .kiro/steering/tech.md and the internal aws-cost-governance.md.

preToolUse.command: sh -c 'f=$(cat | jq -r .tool_input.path // empty); if [ -n "$f" ] && grep -E "anthropic\\.claude-3-(sonnet|opus)" "$f" 2>/dev/null; then echo "Blocked: only anthropic.claude-3-haiku is permitted per aws-cost-governance.md" >&2; exit 2; fi'

sh -c 'f=$(cat | jq -r .tool_input.path // empty); if [ -n "$f" ] && grep -E "(AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}|ghp_[a-zA-Z0-9]{36}|sk-[a-zA-Z0-9]{48})" "$f" 2>/dev/null; then echo "Blocked: hardcoded secret detected. Use Secrets Manager." >&2; exit 2; fi'

postToolUse.command: sh -c 'f=$(cat | jq -r .tool_input.path // empty); [ -n "$f" ] && case "$f" in *.py) ruff check --fix "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; black "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true;; esac'

stop.command: sh -c 'cd "$(cat | jq -r .cwd // empty)" && pytest -q >/dev/null 2>&1; rc=$?; if [ $rc -ne 0 ] && [ $rc -ne 5 ]; then echo "Tests are failing (pytest rc=$rc). Fix them before stopping." >&2; exit 1; fi; exit 0'
